# Contributing to Alchemy

Thanks for your interest in Alchemy.

## Start with an issue or discussion

Please don't open a pull request out of the blue. Start here instead:

- **Bugs:** open an [issue](https://github.com/hostingaccessories/alchemy/issues)
  with steps to reproduce, what you expected, and what happened.
- **Ideas, features, and questions:**
  open a [discussion](https://github.com/hostingaccessories/alchemy/discussions).

If a change makes sense, we'll ask you to open a PR, or we'll make it
ourselves.

## Why

We're all using AI. Writing code is cheap now. Reviewing it, and agreeing on
what to build and how, is not. A few minutes in an issue or discussion settles
the problem and the approach before anyone writes or reviews code. That saves
your time and ours.

Unsolicited PRs may be closed without review. Please don't take it personally.

## If you've been asked for a PR

- Read [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md). Those rules are
  enforced in CI and review.
- Follow [docs/DEVELOPMENT.md](../docs/DEVELOPMENT.md) for setup, and run the
  full gate locally before pushing.
- Keep it focused on the agreed change and link the issue or discussion.
- You're responsible for every line, whoever or whatever wrote it.

## Conduct

Everyone taking part is expected to follow the
[Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
